title: Edit Distance
description:
Find the smallest number of single-character operations needed to turn word1 into word2. Each insertion, deletion, or replacement costs one; leaving a matching character untouched costs zero.

The operations may occur anywhere in the current word. Compare prefixes: their last characters either agree, or a final edit is an insertion, deletion, or replacement. Empty words are allowed.

Example 1:

Input: word1 = "horse", word2 = "ros"
Output: 3

Replace h with r and delete the second r and e.

Example 2:

Input: word1 = "intention", word2 = "execution"
Output: 5

Five edits suffice to change intention into execution, and fewer cannot align the differing prefixes.

Example 3:

Input: word1 = "", word2 = "abc"
Output: 3

Insert a, b, and c into the empty word.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= word1.length, word2.length <= 100
  • Both words contain only lowercase English letters.
